description: Defines the NetworkIsolationKey class used for isolating shared network resources based on request context, including constructors, comparison operators, serialization methods, and accessors for internal fields.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey
classes.description: Class used to isolate shared network stack resources based on request context, supporting different modes of keying and serialization.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey::SerializationPasskey
classes.description: Passkey class for serialization-related access control.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey::CookiePartitionKeyPasskey
classes.description: Passkey class for CookiePartitionKey access control.

methods.name: NetworkIsolationKey
methods.description: Constructors for creating NetworkIsolationKey instances, including full, deserialization, legacy, and default constructors.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Less-than operator for ordering NetworkIsolationKey instances.

methods.name: ToCacheKeyString
methods.description: Returns a string suitable for cache key, or nullopt if transient.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representation of the key.

methods.name: IsFullyPopulated
methods.description: Checks if all parts of the key are populated.

methods.name: IsTransient
methods.description: Checks if the key is transient (short-lived).

methods.name: GetTopFrameSite
methods.description: Returns the top frame site if available.

methods.name: GetFrameSite
methods.description: Returns the frame site if available.

methods.name: GetIsCrossSite
methods.description: Returns whether the frame site is cross-site from the top frame.

methods.name: GetNonce
methods.description: Returns the nonce associated with the key.

methods.name: GetMode
methods.description: Returns the current mode of the NetworkIsolationKey (kFrameSiteEnabled or kCrossSiteFlagEnabled).

methods.name: GetFrameSiteForTesting
methods.description: Returns the frame site for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetFrameSiteForSerialization
methods.description: Returns the frame site for serialization, requires passkey.

methods.name: GetFrameSiteForCookiePartitionKey
methods.description: Returns the frame site for CookiePartitionKey, requires passkey.

methods.name: GetIsCrossSiteForSerialization
methods.description: Returns the cross-site boolean for serialization, requires passkey.
